title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.


The Role

As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.


Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team

You’ll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense’s growth.


Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.
  • Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.
  • Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.
  • Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.
  • Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.
  • Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.
  • Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.
  • Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.
  • Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.
  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.
  • Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.
  • Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.


About You

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred; Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable).
  • Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.
  • SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.
  • Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Solid technical foundation, including experience with:
  • JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have; strong preference for hands-on exposure)
  • REST APIs and platform integrations
  • Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
  • Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.
  • Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.

Role Overview:

Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Analista de Growth Marketing | Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

Qualificações Obrigatórias:

* 8 a 10 anos de experiência em Segurança Oracle HCM Cloud

* Participação comprovada em pelo menos 3 implementações completas (end-to-end) de segurança Oracle HCM Cloud

* Forte expertise em desenho e implementação de RBAC

* Experiência prática com análise de SoD e mitigação de riscos

* Experiência em auditoria de acessos, funções e permissões

* Conhecimento sólido em segurança de Oracle BI dentro do HCM Cloud

* Experiência com Oracle Security Console e configuração de funções customizadas

* Boa compreensão de segurança em Oracle SaaS, gestão de riscos e segurança de processos de RH

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia focada em proteção de marcas, monitoramento digital e compliance no ambiente online. Estamos em rápido crescimento e buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Customer Success para liderar a operação de atendimento B2B, garantindo excelência na experiência do cliente, retenção e expansão de receita.


O que você vai encontrar ao fazer parte da Branddi:

Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!

Ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor: Valorizamos e incentivamos novas ideias. Sua contribuição é essencial para nós!

Espaço para inovação: Buscamos sempre melhorar nossos processos e fluxos, e contamos com você para ajudar nesse processo de aprimoramento.

Integração entre áreas: Em nosso time, todos se conectam e colaboram, criando um ambiente dinâmico e alinhado.

Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de onde se sentir mais confortável com o nosso modelo de home-office.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar e desenvolver o time de Customer Success, acompanhando performance individual e coletiva, promovendo feedbacks constantes e fortalecendo uma cultura orientada a resultados.
  • Gestão da Carteira de Clientes: Garantir excelência no atendimento e relacionamento com clientes B2B, assegurando retenção, satisfação e identificação de oportunidades de expansão.
  • Gestão por Indicadores: Monitorar e evoluir KPIs estratégicos da área, como churn, expansão (upsell e cross-sell), NPS, tempo de resposta e engajamento da base.
  • Processos e Melhoria Contínua: Estruturar, revisar e otimizar fluxos e processos da área de Customer Success, garantindo eficiência, padronização e escalabilidade.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de demandas críticas, apoiando o time em negociações e situações estratégicas com clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em gestão de atendimento ou Customer Success no modelo B2B.
  • Vivência em liderança de times e acompanhamento de metas e indicadores.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de CS, como churn, retenção, expansão e indicadores de satisfação.
  • Familiaridade com ambiente digital e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Perfil comunicativo, analítico e com forte foco em resolução de problemas.


Diferencial: Liderança em e-commerce


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Bônus mensal por resultados.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: AR / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter


Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:

English version only.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . 4. Agile Collaboration

5. Communication & Coordination

Qualifications

Experience

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).

  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

Home Office | PJ


Você será responsável pela visão de produto das ferramentas internas que gestores de portfólio, analistas quantitativos e traders utilizam diariamente. Não se trata de gestão de produtos para o consumidor final — seus usuários gerenciam bilhões e não têm paciência para softwares que os atrasem.

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"


\" Conhecimento da área financeira é imprescindível — não negociável

- Fluxo de trabalho de investimento: Geração de ideias → pesquisa → construção de portfólio → execução → monitoramento → relatórios

- Gestão de portfólio: Ações long/short, multiestratégia, estruturas de alocação, lógica de rebalanceamento, gestão de drawdown

- Risco e conformidade: Limites de posição, risco de concentração, relatórios regulatórios (13F, AIFMD), padrões de relatórios para investidores

- Operações de negociação: Sistemas OMS/EMS, fundamentos do protocolo FIX, verificações de conformidade pré-negociação, alocação de negociações

- Atribuição de desempenho: Atribuição Brinson, decomposição de fatores, relatórios de retorno relativo ao benchmark versus retorno absoluto

- Relações com investidores: Relatórios para LPs, fluxos de trabalho DDQ, fundamentos de contabilidade de fundos, processos de chamada de capital/distribuição


Habilidades

- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de produtos — com pelo menos 3 anos em serviços financeiros, gestão de ativos ou fintech atendendo clientes institucionais

- Você já desenvolveu produtos para investidores profissionais, traders ou gestores de portfólio — não para o varejo

- Capacidade de ler e discutir um relatório de atribuição de fatores Análise detalhada de lucros e perdas ou resumo da exposição ao risco sem glossário

- Experiência com fornecedores de OMS/EMS (Charles River, Advent, Eze ou equivalentes)

- Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar roteiros em ambientes altamente regulamentados e sujeitos a auditorias

- Forte intuição para dados — você consegue escrever SQL e consultar um modelo de dados de forma independente

- MBA ou CFA são um diferencial; experiência comprovada na área é mais importante

We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

custom-built agent workflows
